task: Phase 4: quiet final words (P4.1) and long recordings (P4.3)
setup: ASREvalRunnerTests, ORTTAAI_ASR_EVAL_MODEL=fluid-speech-mini with Word Boost (36 terms), Release, Apple M5 Max. Long recordings from build_long_corpus.py (realistic clips joined with 0.8 s of room noise): 10.0 and 31.1 minutes, fed through the live path at 4x real time with the same snapshot polling as dictation. Memory is the process's physical footprint (Activity Monitor's Memory); the test host uses 18 MB before a model loads.

quiet_final_words.change: ExpressAudioConditioner lifts the last 1.5 s toward the recording's typical speech level when its speech sits below half of it (gain up to 4x, 100 ms ramp).

notes: Word Boost's CTC pass was 5.1 s of the 7.3 s on 10 minutes. It now scores each 15 s chunk (FluidAudio's own chunking, 2 s overlap) while the user is still speaking; stitched, the chunks give exactly FluidAudio's whole-recording scores, and every output matched the earlier runs.

The memory blow-up came from the dictation loop copying the whole recording every 250 ms: each copy is slightly larger than the last, so macOS cannot reuse the freed ones (a standalone repro grows 235 MB per minute; fixed-size copies stay flat). Express now takes a copy only when a Word Boost chunk completes, about every 13 s. Whisper's live path still copies on every poll.
The 450 MB target is not met: Fluid Speech Mini and Parakeet CTC 110M account for about 480 MB once loaded, before any recording.
Live preview in the pill (P4.2) was dropped: the pill shows no text by the user's decision of July 2026, reaffirmed 2026-10-23.
